formation: Noun + (の) + ゆえ(に) / Verb-plain + (が) + ゆえ(に) / i-Adj + (が) + ゆえ(に) / na-Adj + である + がゆえに

examples.ja: 若さゆえの無謀な挑戦だったが、今ではいい思い出だ。
examples.en: It was a reckless challenge born of youth, but now it's a fond memory.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ゆえ(に). Meaning: because of; due to; therefore. Formation: Noun + (の) + ゆえ(に) / Verb-plain + (が) + ゆえ(に) / i-Adj + (が) + ゆえ(に) / na-Adj + である + がゆえに.

meaning_short: other than; apart from (no one / nothing else)
formation: Noun + をおいて(ほかに)〜ない

examples.ja: この難しい手術を任せられるのは、彼をおいてほかにいない。
examples.en: There's no one but him we can entrust with this difficult operation.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜をおいて. Meaning: other than; apart from (no one / nothing else). Formation: Noun + をおいて(ほかに)〜ない.

meaning_short: starting with; beginning with (followed by a series)
formation: Noun + を皮切りに / Verb-plain + の + を皮切りに

examples.ja: バンドは来月の東京公演を皮切りに、全国二十か所を回るツアーを行う。
examples.en: Starting with a concert in Tokyo next month, the band will tour twenty venues nationwide.

source_evidence.source_pattern: を皮切りに（をかわきりに）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜を皮切りに. Meaning: starting with; beginning with (followed by a series). Formation: Noun + を皮切りに / Verb-plain + の + を皮切りに.

meaning_short: taking the opportunity of; with (an event) as a turning point
formation: Noun + を機に / Verb-plain + の + を機に

examples.ja: 還暦を機に、父は長年勤めた会社を退職した。
examples.en: On turning sixty, my father retired from the company he had worked at for decades.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜を機に. Meaning: taking the opportunity of; with (an event) as a turning point. Formation: Noun + を機に / Verb-plain + の + を機に.

meaning_short: as of (and no longer); for the last time; at the top of (one's voice)
formation: Noun + を限りに

examples.ja: 本日を限りに、当店は四十年の歴史に幕を下ろします。
examples.en: As of today, our shop closes its doors after forty years.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜を限りに. Meaning: as of (and no longer); for the last time; at the top of (one's voice). Formation: Noun + を限りに.

meaning_short: with; by means of; as of (a time)
formation: Noun + をもって

examples.ja: 以上をもちまして、本日の説明会を終了いたします。
examples.en: With that, we conclude today's information session.

source_evidence.source_pattern: をもって / をもちまして

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜をもって. Meaning: with; by means of; as of (a time). Formation: Noun + をもって.

meaning_short: in defiance of; undaunted by
formation: Noun + をものともせず(に)

examples.ja: 選手たちは激しい雨をものともせず、最後まで全力で戦い抜いた。
examples.en: Undaunted by the heavy rain, the players fought with all their might to the end.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜をものともせず. Meaning: in defiance of; undaunted by. Formation: Noun + をものともせず(に).

meaning_short: ignoring; paying no heed to; oblivious to
formation: Noun + をよそに

examples.ja: 親の心配をよそに、息子は連日夜遅くまで遊び歩いている。
examples.en: Heedless of his parents' worry, their son is out until late every night.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜をよそに. Meaning: ignoring; paying no heed to; oblivious to. Formation: Noun + をよそに.

meaning_short: in order to; for the sake of (strong resolve)
formation: Verb-nai stem + んがため(に) (する → せんがため)

examples.ja: 彼は夢をかなえんがため、全財産をなげうって留学した。
examples.en: To realize his dream, he gave up everything he owned to study abroad.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜んがため(に). Meaning: in order to; for the sake of (strong resolve). Formation: Verb-nai stem + んがため(に) (する → せんがため).

meaning_short: as if about to; almost (to the point of)
formation: Verb-nai stem + んばかり (する → せんばかり)

examples.ja: 優勝が決まった瞬間、スタジアムは割れんばかりの拍手に包まれた。
examples.en: The moment the championship was decided, the stadium was filled with deafening applause.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜んばかり. Meaning: as if about to; almost (to the point of). Formation: Verb-nai stem + んばかり (する → せんばかり).

meaning_short: now that; since (one must)
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta + うえは

examples.ja: 引き受けたうえは、最後まで責任を持ってやり遂げるつもりだ。
examples.en: Now that I've taken it on, I intend to see it through responsibly to the end.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜うえは. Meaning: now that; since (one must). Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta + うえは.

meaning_short: only; just; nothing but
formation: ただ + Noun + のみ / ただ + Verb-dict + のみ

examples.ja: 今はただ、手術の成功を祈るのみだ。
examples.en: All we can do now is pray that the operation succeeds.

english_breakdown: Pattern: ただ〜のみ. Meaning: only; just; nothing but. Formation: ただ + Noun + のみ / ただ + Verb-dict + のみ.

meaning_short: things like A and B (complaining list)
formation: Noun / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だの + ... + だの

examples.ja: 息子は、野菜は苦いだの肉は硬いだのと文句ばかり言って、なかなか食べない。
examples.en: My son keeps complaining that the vegetables are bitter, the meat is tough and so on, and hardly eats.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜だの〜だの. Meaning: things like A and B (complaining list). Formation: Noun / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だの + ... + だの.

meaning_short: not hesitate to; openly (say, declare)
formation: Verb-te + はばからない

examples.ja: 彼は自分こそが業界一の技術者だと公言してはばからない。
examples.en: He openly declares that he is the best engineer in the industry.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てはばからない. Meaning: not hesitate to; openly (say, declare). Formation: Verb-te + はばからない.

meaning_short: of all people; someone (of such standing) as
formation: Noun + ともあろう + Noun

examples.ja: 警察官ともあろう者が、飲酒運転で捕まるとは。
examples.en: To think that a police officer, of all people, would be caught drunk driving!

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ともあろう. Meaning: of all people; someone (of such standing) as. Formation: Noun + ともあろう + Noun.

meaning_short: using (something) as an excuse or pretext
formation: Noun + にかこつけて

examples.ja: 彼は出張にかこつけて、地方の温泉を巡っているらしい。
examples.en: Apparently he's been using business trips as an excuse to tour hot springs around the country.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜にかこつけて. Meaning: using (something) as an excuse or pretext. Formation: Noun + にかこつけて.

meaning_short: if you ask (someone); in (someone's) opinion
formation: Noun + に言わせれば / Noun + に言わせると

examples.ja: 祖母に言わせれば、最近の若者は我慢が足りないそうだ。
examples.en: According to my grandmother, young people these days lack patience.

source_evidence.source_pattern: に言わせれば（にいわせれば）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に言わせれば. Meaning: if you ask (someone); in (someone's) opinion. Formation: Noun + に言わせれば / Noun + に言わせると.

meaning_short: being too wrapped up in (to attend to other things)
formation: Noun + にかまけて

examples.ja: 仕事にかまけて、家族と過ごす時間をおろそかにしてしまった。
examples.en: Wrapped up in work, I neglected the time I should have spent with my family.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜にかまけて. Meaning: being too wrapped up in (to attend to other things). Formation: Noun + にかまけて.

meaning_short: despite (efforts); to no avail
formation: Verb-ta + かいもなく / Noun + の + かいもなく

examples.ja: 家族の懸命な看病のかいもなく、祖父は静かに息を引き取った。
examples.en: Despite the family's devoted care, my grandfather passed away peacefully.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜かいもなく. Meaning: despite (efforts); to no avail. Formation: Verb-ta + かいもなく / Noun + の + かいもなく.

meaning_short: the most ... in; the best in
formation: Noun + きっての + Noun

examples.ja: 彼女は社内きっての切れ者として知られている。
examples.en: She is known as the sharpest mind in the company.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜きっての. Meaning: the most ... in; the best in. Formation: Noun + きっての + Noun.

meaning_short: even without; without having to
formation: Verb-nai stem + ずとも (する → せずとも)

examples.ja: わざわざ言わずとも、彼なら状況を察してくれるだろう。
examples.en: Even without my spelling it out, he'll probably grasp the situation.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ずとも. Meaning: even without; without having to. Formation: Verb-nai stem + ずとも (する → せずとも).

meaning_short: although; even though; that said
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とはいえ

examples.ja: 春とはいえ、朝晩はまだ冷え込む。
examples.en: Although it's spring, mornings and evenings are still cold.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜とはいえ. Meaning: although; even though; that said. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とはいえ.

meaning_short: as was bound to happen; inevitably
formation: Verb-dict + べくして + Verb-ta (same verb)

examples.ja: 安全点検を怠っていたのだから、あの事故は起こるべくして起こったと言える。
examples.en: Since safety inspections had been neglected, you could say that accident was bound to happen.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜べくして. Meaning: as was bound to happen; inevitably. Formation: Verb-dict + べくして + Verb-ta (same verb).

meaning_short: smack of; seem like (in a bad way); -ish
formation: Noun + じみる / Noun + じみた + Noun

examples.ja: いい大人が、そんな子どもじみた言い訳をするものではない。
examples.en: A grown adult shouldn't make such childish excuses.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜じみる / 〜じみた. Meaning: smack of; seem like (in a bad way); -ish. Formation: Noun + じみる / Noun + じみた + Noun.

meaning_short: including all; the whole (group) together
formation: Noun + ぐるみ

examples.ja: 隣の家とは、家族ぐるみで付き合っている。
examples.en: Our whole family is close with the family next door.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ぐるみ. Meaning: including all; the whole (group) together. Formation: Noun + ぐるみ.

meaning_short: there's a limit to; too ... (beyond what's acceptable)
formation: Noun / na-Adj / i-Adj / Verb-dict + にもほどがある

examples.ja: 約束の時間に二時間も遅れてくるなんて、非常識にもほどがある。
examples.en: Showing up two hours late for an appointment — there's a limit to how inconsiderate you can be.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜にもほどがある. Meaning: there's a limit to; too ... (beyond what's acceptable). Formation: Noun / na-Adj / i-Adj / Verb-dict + にもほどがある.

meaning_short: taking (unfair) advantage of; using (a situation) as license to
formation: Noun + をいいことに / Verb-plain + の + をいいことに

examples.ja: 親が留守なのをいいことに、息子は友達を呼んで夜通し騒いでいた。
examples.en: Taking advantage of his parents being away, the son invited friends over and partied all night.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜をいいことに. Meaning: taking (unfair) advantage of; using (a situation) as license to. Formation: Noun + をいいことに / Verb-plain + の + をいいことに.

meaning_short: in accordance with (rules, law, tradition)
formation: Noun + に則って / Noun + に則った + Noun

examples.ja: 大会は、国際ルールに則って公正に運営される。
examples.en: The tournament will be run fairly in accordance with international rules.

source_evidence.source_pattern: に則って（にのっとって）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に則って. Meaning: in accordance with (rules, law, tradition). Formation: Noun + に則って / Noun + に則った + Noun.

meaning_short: whether A or B; A or B alike (fixed pairs)
formation: i-Adj stem + かれ + i-Adj stem + かれ

examples.ja: 遅かれ早かれ、この秘密はみんなに知られることになるだろう。
examples.en: Sooner or later, everyone will probably find out this secret.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜かれ〜かれ. Meaning: whether A or B; A or B alike (fixed pairs). Formation: i-Adj stem + かれ + i-Adj stem + かれ.

meaning_short: extremely; nothing could be more
formation: i-Adj + ことこの上ない / na-Adj + な + ことこの上ない

examples.ja: 深夜の山道を一人で運転するのは、心細いことこの上ない。
examples.en: Driving alone on a mountain road late at night is as unnerving as it gets.

source_evidence.source_pattern: ことこの上ない / この上ない / この上なく（ことこのうえない / このうえない / このうえなく）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ことこの上ない. Meaning: extremely; nothing could be more. Formation: i-Adj + ことこの上ない / na-Adj + な + ことこの上ない.

pattern_key: とみえる / とみえて
meaning_short: it seems (judging from evidence); apparently
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とみえる / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とみえて

examples.ja: 息子はよほど疲れていたとみえて、夕食も食べずに眠ってしまった。
examples.en: My son must have been really tired — he fell asleep without even eating dinner.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜とみえる / 〜とみえて. Meaning: it seems (judging from evidence); apparently. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とみえる / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とみえて.

meaning_short: based on; taking into account; in light of
formation: Noun + を踏まえて / Noun + を踏まえた + Noun

examples.ja: アンケートの結果を踏まえて、来年度のサービス内容を見直すことにした。
examples.en: Based on the survey results, we decided to review next year's service offerings.

source_evidence.source_pattern: を踏まえて（をふまえて）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜を踏まえて. Meaning: based on; taking into account; in light of. Formation: Noun + を踏まえて / Noun + を踏まえた + Noun.

meaning_short: it's not impossible that; there's a chance that
formation: Verb-nai + とも限らない

examples.ja: 途中で渋滞に巻き込まれないとも限らないから、早めに出発しよう。
examples.en: We might get stuck in traffic on the way, so let's leave early.

source_evidence.source_pattern: ないとも限らない（ないともかぎらない）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ないとも限らない. Meaning: it's not impossible that; there's a chance that. Formation: Verb-nai + とも限らない.

meaning_short: on the occasion of; when; at the time of
formation: Noun + に際して / Verb-dict + に際して / Noun + に際しての + Noun

examples.ja: 新製品の発売に際して、記者会見が開かれた。
examples.en: A press conference was held on the occasion of the new product's launch.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に際して. Meaning: on the occasion of; when; at the time of. Formation: Noun + に際して / Verb-dict + に際して / Noun + に際しての + Noun.

meaning_short: along with; as; accompanying
formation: Noun + に伴って / Verb-dict + の + に伴って / Noun + に伴う + Noun

examples.ja: 高齢化に伴って、医療費は年々増加している。
examples.en: Along with the aging of the population, medical costs are rising year by year.

source_evidence.source_pattern: に伴って（にともなって）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に伴って. Meaning: along with; as; accompanying. Formation: Noun + に伴って / Verb-dict + の + に伴って / Noun + に伴う + Noun.

meaning_short: according to; depending on; in response to
formation: Noun + に応じて / Noun + に応じた + Noun

examples.ja: この奨学金は、家庭の収入に応じて支給額が変わる。
examples.en: The amount of this scholarship varies according to household income.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に応じて. Meaning: according to; depending on; in response to. Formation: Noun + に応じて / Noun + に応じた + Noun.

meaning_short: contrary to; against; in violation of
formation: Noun + に反して / Noun + に反する + Noun / Noun + に反した + Noun

examples.ja: 大方の予想に反して、無名の新人が優勝した。
examples.en: Contrary to most people's predictions, an unknown newcomer won the championship.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に反して. Meaning: contrary to; against; in violation of. Formation: Noun + に反して / Noun + に反する + Noun / Noun + に反した + Noun.

meaning_short: based on; on the basis of
formation: Noun + に基づいて / Noun + に基づく + Noun / Noun + に基づいた + Noun

examples.ja: この映画は実際に起きた事件に基づいて制作された。
examples.en: This film was made based on an incident that actually happened.

source_evidence.source_pattern: に基づいて（にもとづいて）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に基づいて. Meaning: based on; on the basis of. Formation: Noun + に基づいて / Noun + に基づく + Noun / Noun + に基づいた + Noun.

meaning_short: over; throughout; spanning (a whole period or area)
formation: Noun + にわたって / Noun + にわたる + Noun

examples.ja: 工事は三か月にわたって行われる予定だ。
examples.en: The construction is scheduled to take place over three months.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜にわたって. Meaning: over; throughout; spanning (a whole period or area). Formation: Noun + にわたって / Noun + にわたる + Noun.

meaning_short: along; in line with; following
formation: Noun + に沿って / Noun + に沿った + Noun

examples.ja: 川に沿って桜並木が二キロほど続いている。
examples.en: A row of cherry trees stretches for about two kilometers along the river.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に沿って. Meaning: along; in line with; following. Formation: Noun + に沿って / Noun + に沿った + Noun.

meaning_short: in addition to; on top of
formation: Noun + に加えて

examples.ja: 今年は猛暑に加えて雨不足が続き、野菜の価格が高騰している。
examples.en: This year, on top of the extreme heat, there has been a prolonged lack of rain, and vegetable prices have soared.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜に加えて. Meaning: in addition to; on top of. Formation: Noun + に加えて.

meaning_short: over; concerning; surrounding (an issue of dispute)
formation: Noun + をめぐって / Noun + をめぐる + Noun

examples.ja: 新しい空港の建設をめぐって、住民の意見が二つに分かれている。
examples.en: Residents are divided over the construction of a new airport.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜をめぐって. Meaning: over; concerning; surrounding (an issue of dispute). Formation: Noun + をめぐって / Noun + をめぐる + Noun.

pattern_key: を通じて / を通して
meaning_short: through; via; by way of; throughout (a period)
formation: Noun + を通じて / Noun + を通して

examples.ja: 共通の友人を通じて、今の妻と知り合った。
examples.en: I got to know my wife through a mutual friend.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜を通じて / 〜を通して. Meaning: through; via; by way of; throughout (a period). Formation: Noun + を通じて / Noun + を通して.

meaning_short: taking the opportunity of; triggered by; with ... as the start
formation: Noun + をきっかけに / Noun + をきっかけとして / Verb-plain + の + をきっかけに

examples.ja: 大学時代の留学をきっかけに、国際協力の仕事に興味を持つようになった。
examples.en: Studying abroad in college got me interested in international cooperation work.

source_evidence.source_pattern: がきっかけで / をきっかけに

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜をきっかけに. Meaning: taking the opportunity of; triggered by; with ... as the start. Formation: Noun + をきっかけに / Noun + をきっかけとして / Verb-plain + の + をきっかけに.

meaning_short: except; excluding; apart from
formation: Noun + を除いて / Noun + を除き / Noun + を除く + Noun

examples.ja: 年末年始を除いて、図書館は毎日開いている。
examples.en: The library is open every day except during the New Year holidays.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜を除いて. Meaning: except; excluding; apart from. Formation: Noun + を除いて / Noun + を除き / Noun + を除く + Noun.

meaning_short: as if; as though (when it isn't really so)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + かのようだ / na-Adj + である + かのようだ / Noun + である + かのようだ

examples.ja: 彼はまるで何も知らないかのような顔をしていた。
examples.en: He wore a look as if he knew nothing at all.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜かのようだ. Meaning: as if; as though (when it isn't really so). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + かのようだ / na-Adj + である + かのようだ / Noun + である + かのようだ.

meaning_short: could well; might (lead to something bad)
formation: Verb-stem + かねない

examples.ja: そんな無理な運転をしていたら、大事故を起こしかねない。
examples.en: If you keep driving that recklessly, you could end up causing a serious accident.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜かねない. Meaning: could well; might (lead to something bad). Formation: Verb-stem + かねない.

meaning_short: cannot; be unable to (polite refusal); find it hard to
formation: Verb-stem + かねる

examples.ja: 申し訳ございませんが、そのご質問にはお答えしかねます。
examples.en: I'm very sorry, but I'm unable to answer that question.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜かねる. Meaning: cannot; be unable to (polite refusal); find it hard to. Formation: Verb-stem + かねる.

meaning_short: can't help doing; can't resist doing
formation: Verb-nai stem + ずにはいられない

examples.ja: あまりにひどいニュースに、怒りを感じずにはいられなかった。
examples.en: I couldn't help feeling angry at such terrible news.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ずにはいられない. Meaning: can't help doing; can't resist doing. Formation: Verb-nai stem + ずにはいられない.

meaning_short: have no choice but to; cannot help but
formation: Verb-nai stem + ざるを得ない

examples.ja: 予算が足りないので、計画を縮小せざるを得ない。
examples.en: The budget is insufficient, so we have no choice but to scale back the plan.

source_evidence.source_pattern: ざるを得ない（ざるをえない）

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ざるを得ない. Meaning: have no choice but to; cannot help but. Formation: Verb-nai stem + ざるを得ない.

meaning_short: can't afford to (keep) doing; can't just
formation: Verb-te + はいられない

examples.ja: 締め切りが迫っているので、のんびりしてはいられない。
examples.en: The deadline is approaching, so I can't afford to take it easy.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てはいられない. Meaning: can't afford to (keep) doing; can't just. Formation: Verb-te + はいられない.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ごとに. Meaning: every; each; at intervals of. Formation: Noun + ごとに / Verb-dict + ごとに.

meaning_short: right in the middle of; while (busy with)
formation: Verb-te + いる / Noun + の + 最中に

examples.ja: 大事な会議の最中に、携帯電話が鳴ってしまった。
examples.en: My cell phone went off right in the middle of an important meeting.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜最中に. Meaning: right in the middle of; while (busy with). Formation: Verb-te + いる / Noun + の + 最中に.

meaning_short: while (at it); on the occasion of; since one is doing it anyway
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + ついでに

examples.ja: 郵便局へ行くついでに、この手紙も出してきてくれる？
examples.en: Since you're going to the post office, could you mail this letter too?

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ついでに. Meaning: while (at it); on the occasion of; since one is doing it anyway. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + ついでに.

meaning_short: thanks to; because of (good result)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + おかげで

examples.ja: 先輩が手伝ってくれたおかげで、仕事が早く終わった。
examples.en: Thanks to my senior colleague's help, the work was finished early.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜おかげで. Meaning: thanks to; because of (good result). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + おかげで.

meaning_short: because of; due to (bad result, blame)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + せいで

examples.ja: 電車が遅れたせいで、面接に遅刻してしまった。
examples.en: Because the train was delayed, I was late for my interview.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜せいで. Meaning: because of; due to (bad result, blame). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + せいで.

pattern_key: たとたん / たとたんに
meaning_short: the moment; just as (something unexpected happens)
formation: Verb-ta + とたん / とたんに

examples.ja: 立ち上がったとたんに、めまいがした。
examples.en: The moment I stood up, I felt dizzy.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜たとたん / 〜たとたんに. Meaning: the moment; just as (something unexpected happens). Formation: Verb-ta + とたん / とたんに.

meaning_short: when I did A, (I found that) B; upon doing, I discovered
formation: Verb-ta + ら ... Verb-ta

examples.ja: 窓を開けたら、外は一面の雪だった。
examples.en: When I opened the window, everything outside was covered in snow.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜たら〜た. Meaning: when I did A, (I found that) B; upon doing, I discovered. Formation: Verb-ta + ら ... Verb-ta.

meaning_short: even if; no matter (casual)
formation: Verb-ta + って / i-Adj-ku + たって / na-Adj / Noun + だって

examples.ja: 今から急いだって、もう間に合わないよ。
examples.en: Even if you hurry now, you won't make it.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜たって / 〜だって. Meaning: even if; no matter (casual). Formation: Verb-ta + って / i-Adj-ku + たって / na-Adj / Noun + だって.

meaning_short: it's not that ... not; can if necessary; not impossible
formation: Verb-nai / i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + でない + ことはない

examples.ja: 辛い料理は食べられないことはないけど、あまり好きじゃない。
examples.en: It's not that I can't eat spicy food, but I don't really like it.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ないことはない. Meaning: it's not that ... not; can if necessary; not impossible. Formation: Verb-nai / i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + でない + ことはない.

pattern_display: 〜てしょうがない / 〜てしかたがない
pattern_key: てしょうがない / てしかたがない
meaning_short: extremely; can't help (feeling); unbearably
formation: Verb-te / i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で + しょうがない / しかたがない

examples.ja: 昨日あまり寝ていないので、眠くてしょうがない。
examples.en: I barely slept last night, so I'm terribly sleepy.

source_evidence.source_pattern: 〜てしょうがない / 〜てしかたがない

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てしょうがない / 〜てしかたがない. Meaning: extremely; can't help (feeling); unbearably. Formation: Verb-te / i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で + しょうがない / しかたがない.

meaning_short: unbearably; dying to; extremely (feeling)
formation: Verb-te / i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で + たまらない

examples.ja: この部屋はエアコンがなくて、暑くてたまらない。
examples.en: This room has no air conditioning; it's unbearably hot.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てたまらない. Meaning: unbearably; dying to; extremely (feeling). Formation: Verb-te / i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で + たまらない.

meaning_short: only after; not until
formation: Verb-te + はじめて

examples.ja: 病気になってはじめて、健康のありがたさが分かった。
examples.en: It was only after I got sick that I appreciated how precious good health is.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てはじめて. Meaning: only after; not until. Formation: Verb-te + はじめて.

meaning_short: do nothing but; keep on doing (critical)
formation: Verb-te + ばかりいる

examples.ja: 弟は休みの日、ゲームをしてばかりいる。
examples.en: On his days off, my younger brother does nothing but play games.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てばかりいる. Meaning: do nothing but; keep on doing (critical). Formation: Verb-te + ばかりいる.

meaning_short: should; all you need to do is; I hope (with のに/けど: I wish)
formation: Verb-ba + いい / i-Adj stem + ければ + いい

examples.ja: 「この書類、どこに出せばいいですか。」「二階の受付に出してください。」
examples.en: 'Where should I hand in this form?' 'Please take it to the reception desk on the second floor.'

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ばいい. Meaning: should; all you need to do is; I hope (with のに/けど: I wish). Formation: Verb-ba + いい / i-Adj stem + ければ + いい.

meaning_short: in the case of; if; in the event that
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + 場合（は）

examples.ja: 雨の場合は、試合は中止になります。
examples.en: In case of rain, the game will be canceled.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜場合（は）. Meaning: in the case of; if; in the event that. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + 場合（は）.

pattern_key: とすれば / としたら
meaning_short: if; supposing that; assuming
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + とすれば / としたら

examples.ja: もし宝くじで一億円当たったとしたら、何に使いますか。
examples.en: If you won 100 million yen in the lottery, what would you spend it on?

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜とすれば / 〜としたら. Meaning: if; supposing that; assuming. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + とすれば / としたら.

meaning_short: even if; even supposing
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + としても

examples.ja: 親に反対されたとしても、私は留学するつもりだ。
examples.en: Even if my parents are against it, I intend to study abroad.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜としても. Meaning: even if; even supposing. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + としても.

meaning_short: I heard something like; apparently
formation: Sentence + とか

examples.ja: 駅前の本屋、今月で閉店するとか。寂しくなりますね。
examples.en: I hear the bookstore by the station is closing at the end of this month. It'll be sad to see it go.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜とか（hearsay）. Meaning: I heard something like; apparently. Formation: Sentence + とか.

meaning_short: (casual quotation) says that; I heard; as for; what is
formation: Sentence + って / Noun + って

examples.ja: 彼女、今日は来られないって。
examples.en: She says she can't come today.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜って. Meaning: (casual quotation) says that; I heard; as for; what is. Formation: Sentence + って / Noun + って.

meaning_short: I heard that; it means that; in other words
formation: Sentence + ということだ

examples.ja: 駅員さんの話では、事故のため電車は一時間ほど止まるということです。
examples.en: According to the station attendant, trains will be stopped for about an hour because of an accident.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ということだ. Meaning: I heard that; it means that; in other words. Formation: Sentence + ということだ.

meaning_short: what is meant by ... is; ... means; the reason is
formation: Noun / Sentence + というのは

examples.ja: 「割り勘」というのは、食事代などをみんなで同じ金額ずつ払うことです。
examples.en: 'Warikan' means everyone paying the same share of a meal or other bill.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜というのは. Meaning: what is meant by ... is; ... means; the reason is. Formation: Noun / Sentence + というのは.

meaning_short: rather than; not so much A as B
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というより

examples.ja: 今日は涼しいというより、寒いくらいだ。
examples.en: Today it's not so much cool as almost cold.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜というより. Meaning: rather than; not so much A as B. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というより.

meaning_short: considering; for (unexpectedly)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + わりに

examples.ja: この店は値段のわりに、量が多くておいしい。
examples.en: For the price, this restaurant gives you big, tasty portions.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜わりに / 〜わりには. Meaning: considering; for (unexpectedly). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + わりに.

meaning_short: even though; despite (critical, reproachful)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + くせに

examples.ja: 自分では何もしないくせに、人の仕事には文句ばかり言う。
examples.en: He never does anything himself, yet he's always complaining about other people's work.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜くせに. Meaning: even though; despite (critical, reproachful). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + くせに.

meaning_short: from ... through; over (a period or area)
formation: Noun + から + Noun + にかけて

examples.ja: 今夜から明日の朝にかけて、強い雨が降るでしょう。
examples.en: Heavy rain is expected from tonight through tomorrow morning.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜から〜にかけて. Meaning: from ... through; over (a period or area). Formation: Noun + から + Noun + にかけて.

meaning_short: for the first time in (a period); manner, way of doing
formation: Noun + ぶり / Verb-stem + ぶり

examples.ja: 五年ぶりに高校の友達に会って、話が止まらなかった。
examples.en: I saw my high school friends for the first time in five years, and we couldn't stop talking.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ぶり. Meaning: for the first time in (a period); manner, way of doing. Formation: Noun + ぶり / Verb-stem + ぶり.

meaning_short: was it?; did I?; (trying to recall)
formation: Verb-ta / Noun + だ / Noun + だった + っけ

examples.ja: あれ、会議って何時からだっけ？
examples.en: Wait, what time does the meeting start again?

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜っけ. Meaning: was it?; did I?; (trying to recall). Formation: Verb-ta / Noun + だ / Noun + だった + っけ.

meaning_short: I hope; may (wish, prayer)
formation: Verb-stem + ますように / Verb-stem + ませんように

examples.ja: 試験に合格できますように。
examples.en: I hope I pass the exam.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ますように. Meaning: I hope; may (wish, prayer). Formation: Verb-stem + ますように / Verb-stem + ませんように.

meaning_short: pretend to; act as if
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + ふりをする

examples.ja: 母に呼ばれたが、聞こえないふりをしてゲームを続けた。
examples.en: My mother called me, but I pretended not to hear and kept playing my game.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ふりをする. Meaning: pretend to; act as if. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + ふりをする.

meaning_short: suitable for / aimed at; intended for
formation: Noun + 向き / Noun + 向け

examples.ja: この料理は作り方が簡単なので、初心者向きだ。
examples.en: This dish is easy to make, so it's well suited to beginners.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜向き / 〜向け. Meaning: suitable for / aimed at; intended for. Formation: Noun + 向き / Noun + 向け.

meaning_short: tend to; be prone to; often
formation: Verb-stem / Noun + がち

examples.ja: 冬になると、つい家にこもりがちになる。
examples.en: When winter comes, I tend to stay cooped up at home.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜がち. Meaning: tend to; be prone to; often. Formation: Verb-stem / Noun + がち.

meaning_short: a touch of; slightly; somewhat (in that condition)
formation: Noun / Verb-stem + 気味

examples.ja: 少し風邪気味なので、今日は早めに帰ります。
examples.en: I have a bit of a cold, so I'll head home early today.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜気味. Meaning: a touch of; slightly; somewhat (in that condition). Formation: Noun / Verb-stem + 気味.

meaning_short: full of; covered with; riddled with
formation: Noun + だらけ

examples.ja: 子どもたちは、泥だらけになって帰ってきた。
examples.en: The children came home covered in mud.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜だらけ. Meaning: full of; covered with; riddled with. Formation: Noun + だらけ.

meaning_short: do completely; finish / can't finish; too many to
formation: Verb-stem + 切る / Verb-stem + 切れない

examples.ja: 三時間かけて、長い小説を最後まで読み切った。
examples.en: It took three hours, but I read the long novel right to the end.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜切る / 〜切れない. Meaning: do completely; finish / can't finish; too many to. Formation: Verb-stem + 切る / Verb-stem + 切れない.

meaning_short: half-done; start to; be about to
formation: Verb-stem + かける / Verb-stem + かけの + Noun

examples.ja: 読みかけの本が、机の上に置いてある。
examples.en: There's a half-read book on the desk.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜かける. Meaning: half-done; start to; be about to. Formation: Verb-stem + かける / Verb-stem + かけの + Noun.

meaning_short: do to each other; do together
formation: Verb-stem + 合う

examples.ja: 困ったときは、お互いに助け合いましょう。
examples.en: Let's help each other out when things get tough.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜合う. Meaning: do to each other; do together. Formation: Verb-stem + 合う.

meaning_short: redo; do over again (to fix or improve)
formation: Verb-stem + 直す

examples.ja: 名前を間違えたので、書類を書き直した。
examples.en: I got the name wrong, so I rewrote the document.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜直す. Meaning: redo; do over again (to fix or improve). Formation: Verb-stem + 直す.

meaning_short: hard to; difficult or uncomfortable to
formation: Verb-stem + づらい

examples.ja: この靴は少し小さくて、歩きづらい。
examples.en: These shoes are a bit small, so they're hard to walk in.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜づらい. Meaning: hard to; difficult or uncomfortable to. Formation: Verb-stem + づらい.

pattern_key: べきだ / べきではない
meaning_short: should; ought to / should not
formation: Verb-dict + べきだ / Verb-dict + べきではない

examples.ja: 自分が悪いと思ったら、すぐに謝るべきだ。
examples.en: If you think you were in the wrong, you should apologize right away.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜べきだ / 〜べきではない. Meaning: should; ought to / should not. Formation: Verb-dict + べきだ / Verb-dict + べきではない.

meaning_short: nothing is as ... as; there's no ... like
formation: Noun + ほど + i-Adj / na-Adj + な + Noun + はない

examples.ja: 仕事の後に飲む冷たいビールほどおいしいものはない。
examples.en: Nothing tastes as good as an ice-cold beer after work.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ほど〜はない. Meaning: nothing is as ... as; there's no ... like. Formation: Noun + ほど + i-Adj / na-Adj + な + Noun + はない.

meaning_short: have no choice but to; can only
formation: Verb-dict + しかない

examples.ja: 終電に乗り遅れたから、タクシーで帰るしかない。
examples.en: I missed the last train, so I have no choice but to take a taxi home.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜しかない. Meaning: have no choice but to; can only. Formation: Verb-dict + しかない.

meaning_short: even (an extreme case)
formation: Noun + まで / Noun + にまで

examples.ja: 最近は、小学生までスマホを持っている。
examples.en: These days even elementary school kids have smartphones.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜まで（even）. Meaning: even (an extreme case). Formation: Noun + まで / Noun + にまで.

meaning_short: almost; nearly (but didn't)
formation: Verb-dict + ところだった

examples.ja: 考え事をしていて、もう少しで車にひかれるところだった。
examples.en: I was lost in thought and nearly got hit by a car.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ところだった. Meaning: almost; nearly (but didn't). Formation: Verb-dict + ところだった.

meaning_short: just because (... doesn't mean); simply because
formation: Sentence + からといって

examples.ja: 日本人だからといって、みんなが敬語を正しく使えるわけではない。
examples.en: Just because someone is Japanese doesn't mean they can use keigo correctly.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜からといって. Meaning: just because (... doesn't mean); simply because. Formation: Sentence + からといって.

pattern_key: とおりに / どおりに
meaning_short: as; in the way that; exactly as
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + とおりに / Noun + どおりに

examples.ja: 説明書に書いてあるとおりに組み立てたのに、うまく動かない。
examples.en: I put it together exactly as the manual says, but it doesn't work properly.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜とおりに / 〜どおりに. Meaning: as; in the way that; exactly as. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + とおりに / Noun + どおりに.

meaning_short: things like; the likes of (dismissive or humble); how ...! (surprise)
formation: Noun + なんか / Noun + なんて / Sentence + なんて

examples.ja: 私なんか、まだまだ初心者です。
examples.en: Someone like me is still just a beginner.

source_evidence.source_pattern: なんという / なんと / なんて

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜なんか / 〜なんて. Meaning: things like; the likes of (dismissive or humble); how ...! (surprise). Formation: Noun + なんか / Noun + なんて / Sentence + なんて.

pattern_display: あげる / くれる / もらう
pattern_key: あげる / くれる / もらう
meaning_short: give (to someone else); give (to me or my group); receive
formation: Noun (receiver) + に + Noun + を + あげる / Noun (giver) + が + Noun + を + くれる / Noun (giver) + に + Noun + を + もらう

examples.ja: 私は弟に古いゲームをあげた。
examples.en: I gave my old game to my little brother.

source_evidence.source_pattern: あげる / くれる / もらう

english_breakdown: Pattern: あげる / くれる / もらう. Meaning: give (to someone else); give (to me or my group); receive. Formation: Noun (receiver) + に + Noun + を + あげる / Noun (giver) + が + Noun + を + くれる / Noun (giver) + に + Noun + を + もらう.

meaning_short: do something for someone (as a favor)
formation: Verb-te + あげる

examples.ja: 妹の宿題を手伝ってあげました。
examples.en: I helped my little sister with her homework.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てあげる. Meaning: do something for someone (as a favor). Formation: Verb-te + あげる.

meaning_short: someone does something for me (or my group)
formation: Verb-te + くれる

examples.ja: 友達が引っ越しを手伝ってくれた。
examples.en: A friend helped me move.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てくれる. Meaning: someone does something for me (or my group). Formation: Verb-te + くれる.

meaning_short: have someone do something (for me); get someone to do
formation: Verb-te + もらう

examples.ja: 先輩にレポートを見てもらった。
examples.en: I had a senior student look over my report.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てもらう. Meaning: have someone do something (for me); get someone to do. Formation: Verb-te + もらう.

pattern_key: てくださる / ていただく
meaning_short: (honorific) someone kindly does for me; (humble) I receive the favor of someone doing
formation: Verb-te + くださる / Verb-te + いただく

examples.ja: 先生が私の作文を直してくださいました。
examples.en: My teacher kindly corrected my essay.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てくださる / 〜ていただく. Meaning: (honorific) someone kindly does for me; (humble) I receive the favor of someone doing. Formation: Verb-te + くださる / Verb-te + いただく.

meaning_short: do something and go; go on doing (from now into the future)
formation: Verb-te + いく

examples.ja: 雨が降りそうだから、傘を持っていきます。
examples.en: It looks like rain, so I'll take an umbrella.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ていく. Meaning: do something and go; go on doing (from now into the future). Formation: Verb-te + いく.

meaning_short: do something and come back; come doing; (change) up to now; start to
formation: Verb-te + くる

examples.ja: ちょっとコンビニに行ってきます。
examples.en: I'm just popping out to the convenience store.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てくる. Meaning: do something and come back; come doing; (change) up to now; start to. Formation: Verb-te + くる.

meaning_short: finish completely; do by accident; end up doing (with regret)
formation: Verb-te + しまう

examples.ja: 電車に傘を忘れてしまいました。
examples.en: I left my umbrella on the train.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てしまう / 〜ちゃう. Meaning: finish completely; do by accident; end up doing (with regret). Formation: Verb-te + しまう.

meaning_short: do in advance (to prepare); do and leave as is
formation: Verb-te + おく

examples.ja: 旅行の前に、ホテルを予約しておきます。
examples.en: I'll book the hotel before the trip.

matcher.regex: (?:[てで]おく|[ぁ-ゖァ-ヺ一-龯]+とく)

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ておく. Meaning: do in advance (to prepare); do and leave as is. Formation: Verb-te + おく.

meaning_short: try doing (to see what it is like)
formation: Verb-te + みる

examples.ja: このシャツ、着てみてもいいですか。
examples.en: May I try this shirt on?

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てみる. Meaning: try doing (to see what it is like). Formation: Verb-te + みる.

meaning_short: has been done (and stays that way); resulting state of a deliberate action
formation: Verb-te + ある

examples.ja: 入り口に地図がはってあります。
examples.en: There's a map put up at the entrance.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てある. Meaning: has been done (and stays that way); resulting state of a deliberate action. Formation: Verb-te + ある.

meaning_short: when; at the time when
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + とき

examples.ja: 子どものとき、よく川で泳ぎました。
examples.en: When I was a child, I often swam in the river.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜とき. Meaning: when; at the time when. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + とき.

meaning_short: while; during (the whole time); at some point during
formation: Verb-te + いる / Verb-dict / Noun + の + 間（に）

examples.ja: 夏休みの間、祖父の家にいました。
examples.en: I stayed at my grandfather's house during the summer vacation.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜間 / 〜間に. Meaning: while; during (the whole time); at some point during. Formation: Verb-te + いる / Verb-dict / Noun + の + 間（に）.

meaning_short: it seems; it appears (judging from evidence)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + ようだ / na-Adj + な + ようだ / Noun + の + ようだ

examples.ja: 誰もいないようですね。
examples.en: It seems nobody's here.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ようだ. Meaning: it seems; it appears (judging from evidence). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + ようだ / na-Adj + な + ようだ / Noun + の + ようだ.

meaning_short: seems like; looks like; like (casual)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + みたい

examples.ja: 隣の部屋に誰か来たみたい。
examples.en: Sounds like someone has come to the room next door.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜みたい. Meaning: seems like; looks like; like (casual). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + みたい.

meaning_short: too; too much; excessively
formation: Verb-stem / i-Adj stem / na-Adj + すぎる

examples.ja: ゆうべ飲みすぎて、頭が痛い。
examples.en: I drank too much last night, and now I have a headache.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜すぎる. Meaning: too; too much; excessively. Formation: Verb-stem / i-Adj stem / na-Adj + すぎる.

meaning_short: how to; way of doing
formation: Verb-stem + 方

examples.ja: この機械の使い方を教えてください。
examples.en: Please show me how to use this machine.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜方. Meaning: how to; way of doing. Formation: Verb-stem + 方.

meaning_short: in the middle of; during (ちゅう); throughout; all over (じゅう)
formation: Noun + 中

examples.ja: 父は今、電話中です。
examples.en: My father is on the phone right now.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜中. Meaning: in the middle of; during (ちゅう); throughout; all over (じゅう). Formation: Noun + 中.

meaning_short: intend to; plan to
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + つもり

examples.ja: 夏休みは北海道を旅行するつもりです。
examples.en: I intend to travel around Hokkaido during the summer break.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜つもり. Meaning: intend to; plan to. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + つもり.

meaning_short: plan to; be scheduled to
formation: Verb-dict + 予定 / Noun + の + 予定

examples.ja: 来月、大阪に引っ越す予定です。
examples.en: I'm planning to move to Osaka next month.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜予定. Meaning: plan to; be scheduled to. Formation: Verb-dict + 予定 / Noun + の + 予定.

meaning_short: decide to
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことにする

examples.ja: 健康のために、毎朝歩くことにした。
examples.en: I decided to walk every morning for my health.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ことにする. Meaning: decide to. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことにする.

meaning_short: it has been decided that; it turns out that
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことになる

examples.ja: 来年の春から、名古屋の店で働くことになりました。
examples.en: It's been decided that I'll work at the Nagoya store from next spring.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ことになる. Meaning: it has been decided that; it turns out that. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことになる.

meaning_short: can; be able to; be possible to
formation: Verb-dict + ことができる

examples.ja: この図書館では、本を二週間借りることができます。
examples.en: At this library, you can borrow books for two weeks.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ことができる. Meaning: can; be able to; be possible to. Formation: Verb-dict + ことができる.

meaning_short: can; be able to (potential form)
formation: Verb-dict (Group 1: final u → e) + る / Verb-nai stem + られる (Group 2)

examples.ja: 私は漢字が二百ぐらい読めます。
examples.en: I can read about two hundred kanji.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜える / 〜られる（potential）. Meaning: can; be able to (potential form). Formation: Verb-dict (Group 1: final u → e) + る / Verb-nai stem + られる (Group 2).

meaning_short: be done (by someone); passive voice
formation: Verb-nai stem + れる (Group 1) / Verb-nai stem + られる (Group 2)

examples.ja: 先生に作文をほめられました。
examples.en: My essay was praised by my teacher.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜れる / 〜られる（passive）. Meaning: be done (by someone); passive voice. Formation: Verb-nai stem + れる (Group 1) / Verb-nai stem + られる (Group 2).

meaning_short: make someone do; let someone do (causative)
formation: Verb-nai stem + せる (Group 1) / Verb-nai stem + させる (Group 2)

examples.ja: 母は毎日弟に野菜を食べさせる。
examples.en: My mother makes my little brother eat vegetables every day.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜せる / 〜させる. Meaning: make someone do; let someone do (causative). Formation: Verb-nai stem + せる (Group 1) / Verb-nai stem + させる (Group 2).

pattern_key: せられる / させられる
meaning_short: be made to do (against one's will)
formation: Verb-nai stem + せられる (Group 1; short form される) / Verb-nai stem + させられる (Group 2)

examples.ja: 子どものころ、母に毎日ピアノを練習させられた。
examples.en: When I was a child, my mother made me practice the piano every day.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜せられる / 〜させられる. Meaning: be made to do (against one's will). Formation: Verb-nai stem + せられる (Group 1; short form される) / Verb-nai stem + させられる (Group 2).

meaning_short: let's (casual); I'll (volitional form)
formation: Verb-dict (Group 1: final u → o) + う / Verb-stem + よう (Group 2)

examples.ja: 疲れたね。少し休もう。
examples.en: That was tiring, huh? Let's take a short break.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜おう / 〜よう. Meaning: let's (casual); I'll (volitional form). Formation: Verb-dict (Group 1: final u → o) + う / Verb-stem + よう (Group 2).

meaning_short: be thinking of doing; plan to
formation: Verb-volitional + と思う

examples.ja: 今年の夏は海に行こうと思っています。
examples.en: I'm thinking of going to the beach this summer.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜(よ)うと思う. Meaning: be thinking of doing; plan to. Formation: Verb-volitional + と思う.

meaning_short: do it! (imperative form; blunt command)
formation: Verb-dict (Group 1: final u → e) / Verb-stem + ろ (Group 2)

examples.ja: 早く起きろ！遅刻するぞ。
examples.en: Get up already! You'll be late.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜え / 〜ろ. Meaning: do it! (imperative form; blunt command). Formation: Verb-dict (Group 1: final u → e) / Verb-stem + ろ (Group 2).

meaning_short: don't! (strong prohibition)
formation: Verb-dict + な

examples.ja: 危ないから、この川では泳ぐな。
examples.en: It's dangerous, so don't swim in this river.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜な（prohibition）. Meaning: don't! (strong prohibition). Formation: Verb-dict + な.

meaning_short: do (instruction from a parent, teacher, etc.)
formation: Verb-stem + なさい

examples.ja: もう九時よ。早く寝なさい。
examples.en: It's already nine. Go to bed now.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜なさい. Meaning: do (instruction from a parent, teacher, etc.). Formation: Verb-stem + なさい.

meaning_short: if
formation: Verb-ba / i-Adj stem + ければ / na-Adj + なら / Noun + なら

examples.ja: この道をまっすぐ行けば、駅に着きます。
examples.en: If you go straight along this road, you'll reach the station.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ば. Meaning: if. Formation: Verb-ba / i-Adj stem + ければ / na-Adj + なら / Noun + なら.

meaning_short: if; when; after
formation: Verb-ta + ら / i-Adj stem + かったら / na-Adj + だったら / Noun + だったら

examples.ja: 駅に着いたら、電話してください。
examples.en: Please call me when you get to the station.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜たら. Meaning: if; when; after. Formation: Verb-ta + ら / i-Adj stem + かったら / na-Adj + だったら / Noun + だったら.

meaning_short: if (it's the case that); if you're talking about
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + なら

examples.ja: 京都へ行くなら、秋がいいですよ。
examples.en: If you're going to Kyoto, autumn is a good time.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜なら. Meaning: if (it's the case that); if you're talking about. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + なら.

meaning_short: when; if; whenever (natural or automatic result)
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / i-Adj + と / na-Adj + だ + と / Noun + だ + と

examples.ja: このボタンを押すと、お茶が出ます。
examples.en: When you press this button, tea comes out.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜と（conditional）. Meaning: when; if; whenever (natural or automatic result). Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / i-Adj + と / na-Adj + だ + と / Noun + だ + と.

meaning_short: even if; even though
formation: Verb-te + も / i-Adj-ku + ても / na-Adj + でも / Noun + でも

examples.ja: 雨が降っても、試合はあります。
examples.en: Even if it rains, the game will go ahead.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ても / 〜でも. Meaning: even if; even though. Formation: Verb-te + も / i-Adj-ku + ても / na-Adj + でも / Noun + でも.

meaning_short: because; since
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + ので / na-Adj + な + ので / Noun + な + ので

examples.ja: 頭が痛いので、今日は早く帰ります。
examples.en: I have a headache, so I'm going home early today.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ので. Meaning: because; since. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + ので / na-Adj + な + ので / Noun + な + ので.

meaning_short: because; so (cause of a feeling or state)
formation: Verb-te / i-Adj stem + くて / na-Adj + で / Noun + で

examples.ja: ニュースを聞いて、びっくりしました。
examples.en: I was surprised to hear the news.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜て（reason）. Meaning: because; so (cause of a feeling or state). Formation: Verb-te / i-Adj stem + くて / na-Adj + で / Noun + で.

meaning_short: and what's more; and besides (listing reasons)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + し / na-Adj + だ + し / Noun + だ + し

examples.ja: この部屋は広いし、駅から近いし、とても気に入っています。
examples.en: This apartment is spacious and close to the station, so I really like it.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜し. Meaning: and what's more; and besides (listing reasons). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + し / na-Adj + だ + し / Noun + だ + し.

meaning_short: but; although; (soft lead-in)
formation: Sentence + けど / けれども

examples.ja: この店は高いけど、おいしい。
examples.en: This place is expensive, but the food is good.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜けど / 〜けれども. Meaning: but; although; (soft lead-in). Formation: Sentence + けど / けれども.

meaning_short: in order to; for (the sake of); because of
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + ために

examples.ja: 日本の大学に入るために、毎日勉強しています。
examples.en: I study every day in order to get into a Japanese university.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ために. Meaning: in order to; for (the sake of); because of. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + ために.

meaning_short: so that; in order that
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ように

examples.ja: 後ろの人にも聞こえるように、大きな声で話してください。
examples.en: Please speak loudly so that the people in the back can hear too.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ように（purpose）. Meaning: so that; in order that. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ように.

meaning_short: try to; make sure to; make a habit of
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ようにする

examples.ja: 毎日野菜を食べるようにしています。
examples.en: I make a point of eating vegetables every day.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ようにする. Meaning: try to; make sure to; make a habit of. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ようにする.

meaning_short: come to; reach the point where (change in ability or habit)
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ようになる

examples.ja: 練習して、自転車に乗れるようになりました。
examples.en: After practicing, I became able to ride a bike.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ようになる. Meaning: come to; reach the point where (change in ability or habit). Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ようになる.

meaning_short: want someone to do
formation: Verb-te + ほしい / Verb-nai + で + ほしい

examples.ja: もう少しゆっくり話してほしいです。
examples.en: I'd like you to speak a little more slowly.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜てほしい. Meaning: want someone to do. Formation: Verb-te + ほしい / Verb-nai + で + ほしい.

meaning_short: (someone else) wants to
formation: Verb-stem + たがる

examples.ja: 子どもたちは外で遊びたがっている。
examples.en: The children want to play outside.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜たがる. Meaning: (someone else) wants to. Formation: Verb-stem + たがる.

meaning_short: (someone else) feels; shows signs of feeling
formation: i-Adj stem / na-Adj + がる

examples.ja: 妹は暗い所を怖がる。
examples.en: My little sister is scared of dark places.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜がる. Meaning: (someone else) feels; shows signs of feeling. Formation: i-Adj stem / na-Adj + がる.

meaning_short: might; may; possibly
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かもしれない

examples.ja: 午後から雨が降るかもしれません。
examples.en: It might rain in the afternoon.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜かもしれない. Meaning: might; may; possibly. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かもしれない.

meaning_short: probably; I suppose (plain form of でしょう)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + だろう

examples.ja: 明日はたぶん晴れるだろう。
examples.en: It will probably be sunny tomorrow.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜だろう. Meaning: probably; I suppose (plain form of でしょう). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + だろう.

meaning_short: should be; is expected to (based on reasoning)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + はずだ / na-Adj + な + はずだ / Noun + の + はずだ

examples.ja: 荷物は明日届くはずです。
examples.en: The package should arrive tomorrow.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜はずだ. Meaning: should be; is expected to (based on reasoning). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + はずだ / na-Adj + な + はずだ / Noun + の + はずだ.

meaning_short: can't be; there's no way that
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + はずがない / na-Adj + な + はずがない / Noun + の + はずがない

examples.ja: あんなにまじめな人がうそをつくはずがない。
examples.en: There's no way someone that earnest would lie.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜はずがない. Meaning: can't be; there's no way that. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + はずがない / na-Adj + な + はずがない / Noun + の + はずがない.

meaning_short: it's that ...; (explaining or asking for an explanation)
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + んです / na-Adj + な + んです / Noun + な + んです

examples.ja: どうしたんですか。顔色が悪いですよ。
examples.en: What's the matter? You look pale.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜んです / 〜のです. Meaning: it's that ...; (explaining or asking for an explanation). Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + んです / na-Adj + な + んです / Noun + な + んです.

meaning_short: whether or not
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かどうか

examples.ja: 明日行けるかどうか、まだ分かりません。
examples.en: I don't know yet whether I can go tomorrow.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜かどうか. Meaning: whether or not. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かどうか.

meaning_short: embedded question (what, where, who, etc.)
formation: Question word + ... + Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + か

examples.ja: 会議が何時に始まるか、教えてください。
examples.en: Please tell me what time the meeting starts.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜か（embedded question）. Meaning: embedded question (what, where, who, etc.). Formation: Question word + ... + Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + か.

meaning_short: I think that
formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + と思う / na-Adj + だ + と思う / Noun + だ + と思う

examples.ja: この映画はきっと人気が出ると思う。
examples.en: I'm sure this movie will become popular.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜と思う. Meaning: I think that. Formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + と思う / na-Adj + だ + と思う / Noun + だ + と思う.

meaning_short: say that; tell (quotation)
formation: 「Sentence」 + と言う / Sentence (plain) + と言う

examples.ja: 先生は「明日はテストがあります」と言いました。
examples.en: The teacher said, "There's a test tomorrow."

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜と言う. Meaning: say that; tell (quotation). Formation: 「Sentence」 + と言う / Sentence (plain) + と言う.

meaning_short: nothing but; only; all
formation: Noun + ばかり

examples.ja: 弟は肉ばかり食べて、野菜を食べない。
examples.en: My little brother eats nothing but meat and won't touch vegetables.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ばかり. Meaning: nothing but; only; all. Formation: Noun + ばかり.

meaning_short: have just done
formation: Verb-ta + ばかり

examples.ja: 日本に来たばかりなので、まだ日本語がよく分かりません。
examples.en: I've only just come to Japan, so I don't understand Japanese well yet.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜たばかり. Meaning: have just done. Formation: Verb-ta + ばかり.

meaning_short: be about to; be in the middle of; have just done
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / Verb-ta + ところだ

examples.ja: 今から出かけるところです。
examples.en: I'm just about to go out.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ところだ. Meaning: be about to; be in the middle of; have just done. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / Verb-ta + ところだ.

meaning_short: easy to; hard to
formation: Verb-stem + やすい / Verb-stem + にくい

examples.ja: このペンは書きやすいです。
examples.en: This pen is easy to write with.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜やすい / 〜にくい. Meaning: easy to; hard to. Formation: Verb-stem + やすい / Verb-stem + にくい.

pattern_key: 始める / 終わる / 続ける
meaning_short: start doing; finish doing; keep doing
formation: Verb-stem + 始める / Verb-stem + 終わる / Verb-stem + 続ける

examples.ja: 去年からギターを習い始めました。
examples.en: I started learning guitar last year.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜始める / 〜終わる / 〜続ける. Meaning: start doing; finish doing; keep doing. Formation: Verb-stem + 始める / Verb-stem + 終わる / Verb-stem + 続ける.

meaning_short: suddenly start doing; burst out
formation: Verb-stem + 出す

examples.ja: 赤ちゃんが急に泣き出した。
examples.en: The baby suddenly burst out crying.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜出す. Meaning: suddenly start doing; burst out. Formation: Verb-stem + 出す.

meaning_short: not as ... as
formation: Noun / Verb-plain + ほど + i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + ではない

examples.ja: 今年の夏は去年ほど暑くない。
examples.en: This summer isn't as hot as last year.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ほど〜ない. Meaning: not as ... as. Formation: Noun / Verb-plain + ほど + i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + ではない.

meaning_short: not easily; just won't; not readily
formation: なかなか + Verb-nai

examples.ja: バスがなかなか来ない。
examples.en: The bus just isn't coming.

english_breakdown: Pattern: なかなか〜ない. Meaning: not easily; just won't; not readily. Formation: なかなか + Verb-nai.

meaning_short: each; at a time; little by little
formation: Noun (quantity) + ずつ

examples.ja: りんごを一人に二つずつ配った。
examples.en: I handed out two apples to each person.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ずつ. Meaning: each; at a time; little by little. Formation: Noun (quantity) + ずつ.

meaning_short: as many as; as much as; (with a negative) not even one
formation: Noun (number + counter) + も

examples.ja: 昨日は十時間も寝てしまった。
examples.en: I slept for a whole ten hours yesterday.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜も（emphasis）. Meaning: as many as; as much as; (with a negative) not even one. Formation: Noun (number + counter) + も.

meaning_short: by (a deadline); before
formation: Noun / Verb-dict + までに

examples.ja: レポートは金曜日までに出してください。
examples.en: Please hand in the report by Friday.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜までに. Meaning: by (a deadline); before. Formation: Noun / Verb-dict + までに.

meaning_short: sometimes; there are times when
formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことがある

examples.ja: 忙しいときは、朝ご飯を食べないことがあります。
examples.en: When I'm busy, I sometimes skip breakfast.

english_breakdown: Pattern: 〜ことがある. Meaning: sometimes; there are times when. Formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことがある.

pattern_key: ないといけない / なくちゃ
meaning_short: have to; must (conversational)
formation: Verb-nai + といけない / Verb-nai stem + なくちゃ

examples.ja: 明日は早いから、もう寝ないといけない。
examples.en: I have an early start tomorrow, so I need to go to bed now.
